notes: Golden vectors for client chunking. The contract is docs/specs/client-chunked-push.md in entiredb. Generator: internal/xet/client_vectors_test.go.
Xet hashes (chunk, xorb, file) are in Xet text form: four 8-byte limbs, each read as a little-endian uint64 and printed as 16 lowercase hex digits. Entry hex holds the raw 32 bytes.

Input parts: splitmix64 is create_random_data from xet-core: state starts at seed; for each 8 bytes, state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z = state; z = (z ^ z>>30) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z = (z ^ z>>27) * 0x94D049BB133111EB; z ^= z>>31; emit z little-endian. The part is the first size bytes. fill is size copies of byte. slice is bytes [start, end) of an earlier input.
sha256, git_sha1 and git_sha256 check the regenerated input: plain SHA-256, and the Git blob object IDs.
chunk_ends are cumulative end offsets. anchors are chunk indexes whose raw hash ends in 8 bytes that, read as a little-endian uint64, are 0 modulo anchor_modulus.

xorbs: the chunks of the input in order, each compressed alone with xorb.Auto, as xet-go's xorb.Builder does (entiredb's split and git-remote-entire both use it). A xorb is sealed when the next chunk would take it past 8192 chunks or 64 MiB unpacked. The network form is the chunks without a footer and equals xet-go xorb.Encode(chunks, xorb.Auto).Body. The complete form adds the V1 footer with a zero nonce, as xet-go xorb.IngestNetwork returns it.
stored_ends are cumulative ends of each chunk in the network form, including its 8-byte header.

entries: complete meta 0x03 pack entries (type 5 header, meta byte, payload size, payload) and their parsed fields. Recipe "xorbs of the input" has one term per input xorb. Recipe "dedup against <base>" takes each chunk that the base input holds from the base input's only xorb, and puts every other chunk in new_xorbs. The dedup rule is for these vectors only; a client may choose terms another way.
entries do not consider a threshold. The server also refuses an entry whose size is below 64 KiB.
invalid_entries: complete entries that entiredb refuses. error is a substring of entiredb's error text.

invalid_entries.name: chunk end over 8192
invalid_entries.error: chunk end 8193 is over the 8192 chunks of a xorb

invalid_entries.name: terms short of the size
invalid_entries.error: terms unpack to 4194304 bytes, logical size is 4194305

invalid_entries.name: terms past the size
invalid_entries.error: terms unpack to more than the logical size
